title: Appearance
intro: raven.appearance controls tiled-window gaps and window borders. Sizes use logical pixels.

blocks.label: Appearance options
rows: Gap around the tiling area. Default: 8.
Border thickness. Default: 2. Use 0 to disable.

blocks.text: Gap and border widths accept whole numbers from 0 to 65535, constrained to fit the screen. Colors use #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Fullscreen windows have no gaps or border.

blocks.label: Animation options
rows: Duration in milliseconds, from 0 to 2000. Set 0 to disable the visual animation.
